tools.name: claude
tools.purpose: Claude Code CLI: advanced coding agent
tools.headless: pnpm agent ask --agent claude "…"  (raw: claude -p --permission-mode plan, prompt on stdin)

tools.name: codex
tools.purpose: OpenAI Codex CLI: second-opinion reviews, delegated tasks
tools.headless: pnpm agent ask --agent codex "…"  (raw: codex exec --sandbox read-only --ephemeral -, prompt on stdin)
tools.notes: Inside its workspace-write sandbox pnpm cannot start (Corepack needs network); pnpm loop verifies outside it.

tools.name: dsh
tools.purpose: DeepSeek Harness: DeepSeek-model agent (daily driver on the personal PC)
tools.headless: pnpm agent ask --agent dsh "…"  (raw: dsh --profile headless --permission-mode read-only --approval-policy never -)

install.any: no install needed: pnpm tools add dsh --kind agent --command "npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh" (Node ^22.19 or >=24)

tools.notes: Reads AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and .agents/skills/. See tasks/*/studies/STUDIES_dsh-harness.md if present.
